fields.label: Date
fields.description: The day the benefit was granted at the counter, which is the day it belongs to for budget and for a claim - not the day a phone with no signal finally managed to send it.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Where this benefit has reached on its way from a promise at a counter to money changing hands. Editable after submit because settlement happens weeks later and cancelling a row to change its status would delete the accrual the claim is standing on.

fields.label: Order
fields.description: The order this was granted on. Every rupee of consumed budget has to be traceable back to a line somebody actually sold, or the month-end argument has no evidence on either side.

fields.label: Field User
fields.description: Who sold it. On an Incentive row this is also who gets paid, and a payout run that has to rediscover that through the order is a payout run that gets it wrong for the rep who changed territory mid-month.

fields.label: Benefit
fields.options:
Free Goods
Percent Discount
Value Discount
Rate Off
Incentive
fields.description: One row per benefit actually granted rather than one per scheme, because a slab that gave a discount and a free case is settled as two different things by two different people.

fields.label: Item
fields.description: The SKU the benefit was granted against, or the free item given away. Blank where the scheme paid out against the whole cart rather than against anything in particular.

fields.label: Benefit
fields.description: What this benefit cost, in rupees: the discount given, or what the free goods were valued at. An Incentive row carries what the rep earned, which is money that never came off the shop bill and must never be added to a discount total.

fields.label: Free Qty
fields.description: Base units given away on a free-goods row. Kept beside the valuation because a distributor claims for stock he handed over and reconciles in cases, while the budget is spent in rupees.

fields.label: Distributor
fields.description: The party who physically gave the discount or the stock. He is out of pocket from the moment the rep promised it, and this row is what he claims against.

fields.label: Claim
fields.description: Which claim took this accrual off the table. Set when a claim is submitted and cleared when one is cancelled, which is what stops the same benefit being claimed a second time next month. Editable after submit because a claim happens weeks after the accrual and cancelling the row to record one would delete the evidence the claim stands on.

fields.label: Settled On
fields.description: When the money actually moved. A claim marked settled with no date is the first thing anyone disputes.

fields.label: Client UUID
fields.description: Derived by the server from the order's own device uuid and this benefit's position in the result. No device ever creates a ledger row, but the order behind it is routinely pushed twice from a phone that never heard the first answer, and without a key of its own a replay would accrue the same benefit against the budget a second time.
